questions.question: Bouwens等（2025，Semiartificial photoelectrochemistry for CO2 -mediated enantioselective organic synthesis）：摘要中电极催化乙酰苯还原时，使用的阴极电位与参比是什么？1-苯乙醇的对映体过量和转化率分别是多少？

evidence.quote:
When applying a mild cathodic potential (−0.25 V vs the
reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE)), CO2 is reduced to HCOO−using a W-formate dehydrogenase (FDHNvH) from
Nitratidesulfovibrio vulgaris Hildenborough, which then enables the reduction of NAD+ to NADH by an NAD+-cofactor-dependent
formate dehydrogenase from Candida boidinii (FDHCB). Subsequently, an alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) uses NADH generated
from CO2/HCOO−cycling to reduce acetophenone to chiral 1-phenylethanol in good enantiomeric excess (93%) and conversion
yields (38%).

answer_points.text: −0.25 V，相对于RHE；不能与PEC平台的+0.8 V混同。
1-苯乙醇ee为93%，转化率38%；两者不是法拉第效率。

must_not_claim: 不能把ee当收率，也不能把+0.8 V归入同一电催化条件。

questions.question: Dai等（2025，Surface engineering on bulk Cu2O for efficient electrosynthesis of urea）：摘要报告的尿素生成速率、法拉第效率与对应电位分别是多少？请保留质量归一化单位和参比。

We achieve urea production
rate of 632.1 μg h−1mgcat.
−1 with a corresponding Faradaic efﬁciency of 42.3% at

answer_points.text: 尿素生成速率632.1 μg h−1 mgcat.−1。
对应FE 42.3%，−0.3 V vs RHE，环境条件。

must_not_claim: 不能改写为氨产率或把质量归一化当面积归一化。

questions.question: Fan等（2025，Boosted charge and proton transfer over ternary coCo3O4CoB for electrochemical nitric oxide reduction to ammonia）：作者如何解释三元Co/Co3O4/CoB中不同位点对水解离与NO吸附的分工？

CoB and Co/Co3O4 yields electron-deﬁcient Co and electron-rich Co3O4. The
electron-deﬁcient Co sites boost H2O dissociation to generate *H while the
electron-rich low-coordination Co3O4 sites promote NO adsorption. The *H
formed on electron-deﬁcient Co sites is more favorable to transfer to electron-
rich Co3O4 sites adsorbed with NO, facilitating the selective hydrogenation of
NO. This study

answer_points.text: 电荷转移形成缺电子Co和富电子Co3O4；缺电子Co促进水解离生成活性氢。
富电子低配位Co3O4促进NO吸附，Co位点生成的活性氢向其转移以促进NO氢化。

must_not_claim: 不能把水解离与NO吸附的两类位点反置。

questions.question: Guo等（2025，Lattice hydrogen involved electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to hydroxylamine）：为什么这项硝酸盐制羟胺研究选择晶格氢而不是单纯增加水解离产生的活性氢？

evidence.quote:
On the one hand,
insufficient *H would lead to the accumulation of nitrite. On the
other hand, sufficient *H with high reduction ability would induce
over-hydrogenation of hydroxylamine to ammonia. To overcome this
challenge, herein, we propose to utilize lattice hydrogen (Hlat) with
an appropriate reduction ability as the H-source for ENRH.

answer_points.text: 活性氢不足会积累亚硝酸盐，过多且还原性强会使羟胺过度氢化为氨。
选用还原能力适当的晶格氢作为选择性制羟胺的氢源。

must_not_claim: 不能把目标产物写成氨，也不能认为越多活性氢总越好。

questions.question: He等（2025，Hexafluorophosphate additive enables durable seawater oxidation at ampere-level current density）：摘要中NiFe LDH海水氧化阳极在两档安培级电流密度下分别运行了多久？

achieving prolonged operation for over
5,000 hours at 1 A cm−2 and 2300 hours at 2 A cm−2 using NiFe layered double

answer_points.text: 1 A cm−2下运行超过5000小时。

questions.question: Kuai等（2025，Dissolved fe species enable a cooperative solid–molecular mechanism for the oxygen evolution reaction on NiFe-based catalysts）：这项NiFe基OER研究提出的固体–分子协同机理是什么？溶解出的Fe物种参与哪一步？

2− species,

between the transition metal (TM) magnetic moments and the limiting potential

intermediate spin state of TMs is more favorable for the adsorption and conversion
of CO2. Optimal

answer_points.text: 过渡金属磁矩与CO2还原限制电位呈火山关系。

questions.question: Niemann等（2025，In situ neutron reflectometry reveals the interfacial microenvironment driving electrochemical ammonia synthesis）：LiBF4电解液下，低电流循环与增大或持续电流循环得到的SEI层结构有什么不同？

answer_points.text: 低电流循环<2 mA/cm2下有厚而弥散外层与薄而致密内层。

ceeds to construct the C═N bond for cyclohexanone
oxime. Using

questions.question: Yoo等（2025，Excess cations alter CO intermediate configuration and product selectivity of Cu in acidic electrochemical CO2 reduction reaction）：过量Cs+对酸性Cu表面CO吸附构型及产物分布有什么影响？聚合物黏结剂如何缓解？

evidence.quote:

surface-enhanced infrared absorption spectroscopy (ATR-SEIRAS) reveals that
increasing the Cs+ concentration shifts the preference of the *CO intermediate on
the Cu surface from the atop (*COatop) to the bridge (*CObridge) configuration.
This transition leads to a sharp decline in C−C coupling and an increase in the
hydrogen evolution reaction at high Cs+ concentrations (0.7 and 1.0 M) under
acidic conditions. Time-resolved SEIRAS scans show that *COatop is kinetically
dominant and the proportion of *CObridge increases gradually only at high cation concentrations. Density functional theory
simulations confirm that Cs+ on the Cu surface can interact electrostatically with *CO and stabilize *CObridge over *COatop on the
Cu surface. The evolution of *CObridge is also observed on Ag catalysts, indicating that the effect at high concentrations is not limited
to Cu. Furthermore, polymeric binders on the Cu surface mitigate these detrimental effects on the CO2RR and restore C2H4
production by preventing the cation from altering the *CO adsorption sites on the catalyst surface.

answer_points.text: 高Cs+使CO吸附由顶位偏向桥位，降低C–C偶联并增强析氢。
聚合物黏结剂阻止阳离子改变CO吸附位点，减轻不利影响并恢复C2H4生成。

must_not_claim: 不能将增加Cs+一概描述为持续提高C2选择性。

questions.question: Niemann等（2025，In situ neutron reflectometry reveals the interfacial microenvironment driving electrochemical ammonia synthesis）：原位中子反射同位素对比中，质子供体与溶剂分别影响SEI哪一层？缺少质子供体时观察到什么？

evidence.quote:
We used isotope contrast methods with d6-EtOH and d8-THF to drive time-resolved
tracking of SEI growth at low current cycling, revealing that the proton donor modifies the inner layer, and the solvent modifies the
outer layer. Li dendritic growth was observed in the absence of a proton donor.

answer_points.text: d6-EtOH/d8-THF对比表明质子供体影响内层、溶剂影响外层。

answer_points.text: 用阳离子交换膜组件反转水的电渗拖曳，实现醇产物回收。

questions.question: Yang等（2025，Electronic structure tuning in Cu–Co dual single atom catalysts for enhanced COOH spillover and electrocalytic CO2 reduction activity）：CuCo双单原子催化剂中，Co和相邻Cu分别承担怎样的CO2还原中间体功能？

evidence.quote:
In situ spectroscopy and DFT calculations reveal a synergistic mechanism: Co sites activate
CO2 and stabilize *COOH intermediates, while adjacent Cu sites facilitate CO desorption by lowering the energy barrier
through charge redistribution. This dynamic buffer system mitigates active-site blocking and suppresses HER by weakening
H adsorption.

answer_points.text: Co活化CO2并稳定COOH中间体。
相邻Cu通过电荷重分布降低CO脱附势垒；动态缓冲减轻活性位点堵塞并弱化H吸附抑制HER。

must_not_claim: 不能把Co与Cu的功能反置，也不能说该设计增强HER。
